subject: pe
title: EPOC and Recovery
welcome_lead: After exercise, oxygen consumption stays elevated — pay the metabolic debt.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on EPOC, oxygen debt and supercompensation.
final_note: Recovery is where adaptation happens — train the rest as well as the rep.

concepts.def: Excess Post-exercise Oxygen Consumption; elevated VO₂ post-exercise.
Fast EPOC phase restoring PCr and ATP (~3 min).
Slow EPOC phase clearing lactate and restoring glycogen (up to 24 h).
Performance peak above baseline after adequate recovery.
Restoration of muscle glycogen post-exercise; fastest in first 2 h.
Maladaptive state when recovery is insufficient.

walkthroughs.body_html: Alactacid phase rapidly refills PCr stores. Lactacid phase clears lactate (Cori cycle) and refills glycogen.
After stress, fatigue subsides and capacity overshoots baseline. Train again at the supercompensation peak.
Combining carbs (~1 g kg⁻¹ h⁻¹) and protein (~0.4 g kg⁻¹) maximises glycogen and protein synthesis early post-exercise.
